note: Paired server-validator and Duda renderer cases. Every case is built by omitting named top-level keys and then replacing the named overrides on `base`. `serverValid` records the authoritative `validatePublicFeed` verdict; every case must remain renderable by Duda, while `dudaGallery` records how many governed gallery images survive normalization. Unsafe optional URLs and snapshot pairs are removed without rejecting the record. All data is synthetic.

base.title: Contract Case Baseline Showcase
base.summary: A synthetic record that pairs the authoritative feed validator with the Duda renderer.
base.background: The renderer and the server validator must agree on which public records are legitimate.
base.solution: Each case below fixes one field so a single contract rule can be proven on both sides.
base.posterText: Contract baseline poster full text for the synthetic paired-contract fixture.

cases.name: disciplines-omitted
cases.why: The authoritative validator treats disciplines as recommendation-only, so the renderer falls back to the primary discipline instead of rejecting the record.

cases.name: recommended-fields-omitted
cases.why: Warning-only indexing and presentation fields use empty display defaults and never determine whether the project remains available.

cases.name: featured-media-omitted
cases.why: The authoritative validator does not require featuredMedia, so the renderer applies its documented automatic media selection.

cases.name: section-order-omitted
cases.why: The authoritative validator does not require sectionOrder, so the renderer uses the documented reusable detail order.

cases.name: featured-media-auto-video
cases.why: The authoritative import mapping emits featuredMedia "auto" and the server validator does not reject it. Auto must elevate the video first.

cases.name: featured-media-auto-gallery
cases.why: With no video present, auto must fall back to the governed gallery before the poster.

cases.name: gallery-position-two
cases.why: The server contract permits a unique galleryPosition from 1 through 10 without requiring contiguity, so one image at position 2 must stay visible.

snapshotMedia.altText: Sole synthetic gallery image published at governed position two.

cases.name: gallery-positions-two-and-five
cases.why: Unique increasing non-contiguous positions are server-valid and must both render in snapshots display order.

snapshotMedia.altText: Synthetic gallery image published at governed position two.
Synthetic gallery image published at governed position five.

cases.name: three-image-gallery
cases.why: Three images make a duplicated keyboard handler produce a distinguishable lightbox result.

cases.name: external-query-urls
cases.why: General external HTTP(S) links legitimately carry query strings, including YouTube watch URLs.

cases.name: signed-supabase-video
cases.why: The server rejects a signed Supabase Storage video URL, and Duda independently removes that optional field while retaining the project.

cases.name: signed-supabase-external-link
cases.why: The server rejects a signed Supabase Storage external link, and Duda independently removes that link while retaining the project.

cases.name: authenticated-supabase-demo-url
cases.why: An authenticated Supabase Storage route is never a public asset; the server rejects it and Duda removes the optional demo field.

cases.name: encoded-private-supabase-poster
cases.why: The private bucket name survives percent encoding; the server rejects it and Duda removes only the poster field.

cases.name: encoded-signed-supabase-video
cases.why: A percent-encoded /storage/v1/object/sign/ route is rejected by the server and removed from the retained Duda record.

cases.name: encoded-private-supabase-snapshot
cases.why: Lower-case percent encoding of the private bucket must fail on the server validator and at the Duda boundary. The record still publishes; only the unsafe gallery entry is removed.

snapshotMedia.altText: Encoded private bucket snapshot that must never render.

cases.name: encoded-authenticated-supabase-snapshot
cases.why: Mixed-case percent encoding of the authenticated storage route must fail on both sides. The record still publishes; only the unsafe gallery entry is removed.

snapshotMedia.altText: Encoded authenticated storage snapshot that must never render.

cases.name: double-encoded-private-supabase-snapshot
cases.why: A double-encoded private bucket name resolves to the private path after another decode and must fail closed. The record still publishes; only the unsafe gallery entry is removed.

snapshotMedia.altText: Double-encoded private bucket snapshot that must never render.

cases.name: malformed-percent-supabase-snapshot
cases.why: Malformed percent-encoding cannot be canonicalized, so the policy must fail closed rather than guess. The record still publishes; only the unsafe gallery entry is removed.

snapshotMedia.altText: Malformed percent-encoded snapshot that must never render.

cases.name: tokenized-supabase-poster
cases.why: Token-bearing Supabase Storage is private access; the server rejects it and Duda removes only the poster field.

cases.name: javascript-scheme-video
cases.why: Dangerous URL schemes fail server validation and are removed by Duda before they can reach an active attribute.

cases.name: vbscript-scheme-external-link
cases.why: The server rejects vbscript external links, and Duda independently removes the bad link without dropping the project.

cases.name: data-scheme-snapshot
cases.why: A data: snapshot URL is rejected by the server validator and must not render. The record still publishes; only the unsafe gallery entry is removed.

snapshotMedia.altText: Data URL snapshot that must never render.

cases.name: credentialed-demo-url
cases.why: Embedded credentials are never public-safe; the server rejects the URL and Duda removes the optional demo field.
